title: feat(spec)!: retire the view-level `api` data source — a view binds its object or static rows; an API call is the page element's binding (#23082)
body:
Fixes #23082
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Ruling `6134088274` (batch #331 item 5, letter C): the view-level `api` data source retires under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. A view binds its object or static rows; a metadata-declared API call is the page element's `dataSource` binding (the #23016 rule, PR #23079), same-origin and credential-free. Executed per the `spec-property-retirement` playbook as a VALUE retirement (the retired bare-string `sort` clause's route): `data` survives one arm lighter, so there is no `retiredKey()` tombstone and no `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row — the prescription rides `ViewDataSchema`'s own discriminated-union `error` map, keyed on the input's `provider === 'api'`, so every other unknown provider keeps zod's default report (which lists the three live arms).

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — the `provider: 'api'` arm of `ViewDataSchema` (its `read` / `write` `HttpRequestSchema` blocks and the arm's own near-miss guidance) is removed; the union carries `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED` as its `error` map. Two stale prose sites in the same file no longer teach the arm (the gantt `objectField` describe, the form `data` docblock). `HttpRequestSchema` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` and their `ui` re-exports are untouched; the page-element `api` binding (`ElementApiDataSourceSchema`, `ui/page.zod.ts`) is untouched.
- ADR-0087: D3 semantic entry `view-data-api-provider-retired` (`migrations/entries/semantic/18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts`) and its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 95). **No D2 conversion, deliberately**: the replacement lives on a different metadata type (a page element), and the only mechanical edit a conversion could make — deleting the view's `data` so the view falls back to querying its bound object — would silently change what the view shows. An authored source or a stored row still carrying the arm is refused at parse with the prescription (the `rest-api-endpoint-handler-status-retired` / `kernel/Manifest:loading` no-D2 precedents).
- Liveness ledger `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`: `list.data` and `form.data` stay `live` (their surviving arms are read) and carry the arm's retirement record; `list.data` gains `verifiedAt` / `evidenceScope: cross-repo` with objectui read points cited at `7578323a544e`. **A renderer reader existed in objectui, measured at `7578323a544e`** (`.objectui-sha` on `main` is `1fb1ced36243`; the next cross-repo re-measure re-reads `ListView.tsx` / `ObjectGantt.tsx` there; `ListView.tsx` routed an `api` block to `ApiDataSource`, `ObjectGantt.tsx` built one from the block's `read` / `write`) **and is now unreachable from authored metadata.** The ledger has no per-arm row (the walk never descends a union arm), so the record sits on the key's row; the README's per-type counts do not move.
- `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`: the union key is now `provider:object|schema|value`.
- Pins: `src/ui/view-data-api-provider-retirement.test.ts` — the refusal at `provider` / `data.provider` / `list.data.provider` with its prescription, the three surviving arms value-for-value and still closed, zod's default report for any other unknown provider, the D3 registration and the absence of any key row, and a **tree-scoped absence scan** over the authored spelling (TS / JSON / YAML dialects; the page element's `dataSource: { provider: 'api' … }` deliberately does not match). It joins the spec `repo` vitest project and is the second witness on the #15513 absence-walk rows in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`. The four fixtures that pinned the arm were re-judged: two accept pins replaced by one refusal control (`view.test.ts`), the kanban fixture moved to the `value` arm (its point is a non-object source), the batch-18 strictness row for the arm removed, the `component-props-unknown-members` ledger loses its `HTTP_REQUEST` lines (no `data` member reaches a request block any more) and now refuses their return, and the two `@objectstack/lint` fixtures that used the arm to mean "a non-`object` provider" use the `value` arm.
- Teaching: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` loses the view-level example and points at [Element data sources](/docs/ui/pages#element-data-sources); `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` the same (readings below); the generated reference pages regenerate (`gen:docs`), the strictness counts shard regenerates (`ui/view.zod.ts` strict sites 60 → 59).
- Changeset `.changeset/23082-view-data-api-provider-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING, FROM → TO, one-line fix, the prescription verbatim, `adr-0087: registered view-data-api-provider-retired`.

## Measurements the ruling asked for

- **Producers of a view-level `provider: 'api'`, outside documentation** — each repo with a lit control in the same run:
  - objectstack at `bcebd8409` (this branch's base): 0 outside `packages/spec/src/**` (its own tests), `CHANGELOG.md`, generated reference pages, the two hand-written docs pages and the skill rule file; control `provider: 'object'` 150 files. The only `case 'api':` reader in a runtime package (`service-automation` `engine.ts`) switches on a flow trigger kind, not on `ViewData`.
  - hotcrm at `0f84c9c`: 0; control `provider: 'object'` in 5 view files (`src/*/views/*.view.ts`).
  - objectui at `origin/main` `f228d710`: 0 authored producers. `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` constructs `new ApiDataSource({ read: { url, method, params? }, fetch })` in code — an `ApiDataSourceConfig`, never a `ViewData`; the phrase `provider: 'api'` there is its docblock. **Not a fork.** Note for the objectui follow-up: its "delete `ApiDataSource` and its `related-count-store` use" step must keep or re-home the approvals route (three construction sites in that file). The 29 non-test `provider: 'api'` / `=== 'api'` sites are readers (ListView, ObjectGantt, `resolveDataSource`, `ViewDataProvider`, `useViewData`, `createAuthenticatedFetch`), the objectui follow-up's population. `packages/types` re-exports `type ViewData` / `type HttpRequest` from the spec and declares no `provider: 'api'` view type of its own; `ViewDataProvider.ts` carries an in-code `ViewDataConfig` union with an `api` member that does not derive from the spec. Control: `provider: 'object'` 169 files.
  - cloud: NOT MEASURED from this session (the ruling's 「同意」 covers it); the changeset says so.
- **`write` leg**: no producer anywhere above (the fork clause's second trigger).
- **`HttpRequestSchema` readers** (`packages/**`, excluding dist): `ui/view.zod.ts` (the removed arm, and the `ui` re-export at line 108 — kept), `shared/http.test.ts`, `ui/view.test.ts` (single-source and backward-compat pins — kept), `scripts/schema-index.test.ts` (a fixture), `scripts/build-docs.ts` (a comment), `ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` (the `HTTP_REQUEST` lines — removed here), plus the generated shards (`api-surface`, `authorable-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `json-schema.manifest` for `shared/HttpRequest` and `ui/HttpRequest`; `contracts.json` names the unrelated `IHttpRequest`). **After this change no schema in the package composes `HttpRequestSchema`**: its remaining readers are the two public re-exports and tests. Left in place per the ruling ("touches only the `ViewDataSchema` branch"); the orphan — and the now-stale describes on `HttpMethod` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` that still say "what view data sources may request" — is recorded in the acceptance notes for a follow-up, not acted on here.
- **Console Pin Gate**: `scripts/build-console.sh` injects this tree's spec only through the console SPA's Vite hook (`OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`, `apps/console/vite.config.ts`); objectui's `tsc`-building packages (`types`, `core`, `react`, `app-shell`) type-check against the published spec in objectui's own lockfile (`^17.x`), so the arm's removal cannot red that gate on a type, and no objectui file at the pin parses authored `provider: 'api'` metadata at build time.
- **Ratchets, by route**: a value retirement is byte-invisible to the four ratchets, and it was — `api-surface/`, `authorable-surface/` (+ `.base.json`), `export-origins/`, `declaration-map/`, `json-schema.manifest/` all green and unchanged (`check:generated` on the built tree). What did move: `content/docs/references/**` (the `data` type column; the gantt's nested `data[provider='api']` section), the strictness counts shard, and (prose only) `references/system/migration.mdx`.

## `skills/**` readings (Tier H; net budget ≤ 0)

| file | lines before → after | tokens (`ceil(bytes/4)`) before → after | ceiling |

The replacement pointer ("A view never calls an API: an API read is a page element's `dataSource` binding") costs less than the example it replaces. `check:skills-token-ratchet` green.

## Verification

Head `be64fe664` (= `41045ab6f` + a merge of `origin/main` `287fd6e5d` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` + the hand-off commit regenerating `component.mdx`). Every exit code below was captured before any pipe; builds and tests ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and are quoted from its `VERDICT command-exit` lines.

- **① dependency closure:** `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` — the diff touches `packages/spec` (built, `command-exit 0`, three times on this head's tree) and `packages/lint` (tests only; its closure spec + formula + sdui-parser built, then `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/objectql`, `command-exit 0`).
- **② the touched packages' own suites, on this head:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (gen:migration-registry, `tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:test-typecheck`: OK, 52 files / 246 errors / 135 pinned signatures held — the retirement pin compiles clean) · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (the `local` project): **660 test files passed** · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: **58 files / 1007 tests passed** (the retirement pin's refusal, controls, D3 registration and the tree-scoped absence walk are in this project) · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: OK · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: **138 files / 6649 passed, 5 skipped**. Downstream importers of `ViewData` / `ViewDataSchema` outside spec: none in any `src/` (`git grep`; the two hits are release-owned CHANGELOGs), so no consumer package owes a typecheck for the narrowed type; the full closure is CI's `TypeScript Type Check`.
- **③/④ the gate union, derived on this head:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → **135 commands** (the PM's lead list of 100 plus 35 the tree adds; none dropped), every one run on `be64fe664` with its exit recorded, then `--ran` reconciled with every exit code recorded (`COMMAND :: exit N` per line): `Run reconciliation — 135 derived, 132 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (the 3 derived from recorded exit 3s), reconcile exit 0. **131 exit 0.** The rest, each read at its own log, none a finding against this diff:
  - `pnpm check:platform-checklist` — exit **1**, inherited: 8 ABSENT SYMBOL / anchor-floor problems in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{access-security,attachments-storage,search}.json` citing `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#anonymousFormIntakeOrgScopeRefusal`, `#anonymousFormIntakeReopenRefusal`, `#envWideRawViewRows`, `#countable` and `service-storage/.../attachment-access-hooks.ts#canEdit`. All four protocol symbols are absent on `origin/main` (`287fd6e5d`) and on this branch's base (`bcebd8409`) alike; this diff touches none of those files. A main-red for its lane (`e5f9f0160` / `c8a9783ec` are the main commits that moved `protocol.ts` since the base); reported, not repaired here.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` — exit **3**, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its client-SDK surface reads `@objectstack/client-react`'s built output, which needs the `core` closure built; the shared verify lock was held by other seats' builds for two full queue budgets (holders named in the logs), so it is **NOT MEASURED** here. Narrowing stated, not assumed: the gate type-checks only `os:check`-marked blocks, and neither edited block is marked (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` markers at 17/166/221, the Data Source block at 38–50 is unmarked; `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` markers at 13/168/426/472, the block at 295 is unmarked; `view.zod.ts` carries no marker), so its verdict is invariant under this diff; CI runs it.
  - `pnpm check:type-check-debt` — exit **3**, NOT MEASURED: it builds twelve packages itself and `@objectstack/core#build` collided with a concurrent build of mine under the lock (the batch's own log says so); spec's and lint's `tsc --noEmit` ran green directly (②), so their rows cannot have moved; CI re-measures.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — exit **3**, NOT MEASURED: it loads every package's built output and 53 of 68 workspace packages (adapters, apps) are unbuilt in this worktree; a whole-workspace build is CI's run.
  - Four more refused at first only because `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/objectql` were not yet built, and were **re-run green (exit 0) on this head once they were**: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:lean-entry-closure`.
- **Generated artifacts:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` on this head: **all 14 up to date** (`check:docs`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:liveness`, `check:test-typecheck`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:declaration-map` … all ✓). The 14 pure source audits it does not run were run as one group on the built tree: all ✓ except `check:skill-examples` (above).
- **Repo-level scans** (`pnpm lint` and the farm) are CI's; this PR adds no lint-relevant surface.

## Acceptance notes

- **`HttpRequestSchema` / `HttpMethodSubsetSchema` orphaned** (class b candidate, `carrier:` the spec seat's follow-up or the objectui follow-up card): zero schema readers in `@objectstack/spec` after this PR; both still exported from `./shared` and `./ui`, and their describes still speak of "view data sources". objectui's `packages/types` imports `HttpRequestSchema` from the spec in a test and re-exports `type HttpRequest`, so a def retirement is cross-repo and belongs with the objectui follow-up (the cross-repo unlock rule). Not touched here per the ruling.
- **objectui follow-up population** (another seat's card, filed when the spec release is installable): `ApiDataSource`, `resolveDataSource`'s `'api'` arm, `ViewDataProvider.resolveApi`, `useViewData`'s `provider === 'api'` branches, `createAuthenticatedFetch`'s `provider: 'api'` lane, the gantt's adapter arm, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` (teaches a gantt `data: { provider: 'api' }`), `plugin-calendar.mdx` / `plugin-map.mdx` (mention it as not honoured), and `packages/core/src/adapters/README.md`. The approvals route constructs `ApiDataSource` directly and must be kept or re-homed.
- `sdui.manifest.json` (repo root; generated from objectui's built tree at the pin by `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`) still describes the gantt's `data` as accepting `{ provider: 'api', read }`; it regenerates on the next pin bump, not here.
- Stored `sys_metadata` view rows carrying the arm (none measured; cloud unmeasured) are refused at rehydration with the prescription — loud by design, the D3 entry says what to do.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 视图(列表/表单)的 `data` 数据源不再接受 `provider: 'api'`(自带 `read` / `write` 请求块、任意 `url` 与 `headers` 的那一种)。视图只绑定对象(`object`)或静态行(`value`);元数据里声明的 API 调用只剩一条路:页面元素的 `dataSource` 绑定(同源、不带凭据、用控制台登录态请求)。写了旧写法的视图在校验、发布、保存时被拒绝,错误信息里直接写明改法。对外技能文本与文档同步改成指向页面元素绑定;spec 发一个 minor 版本并带 BREAKING 说明与迁移对照表。

**为什么改:** 您在 #23082 批了 C。旧的视图级 API 源可以把密钥写进 `headers`、把请求指向任意域名,这些会随视图一起存储、下发给每个读取该视图的客户端、并由控制台照原样发出;而页面元素那条路已经按 #23016 的规则锁死。同一件事两套规则,按裁决保留受治理的那一套、撤掉另一套。实测三个仓(objectstack、objectui、hotcrm)都没有视图在用它;cloud 未测,您的「同意」已覆盖。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 风险在未测的存量元数据:若 cloud 或某个客户项目有视图写了 `provider: 'api'`,升级后该视图加载时会被拒绝并给出改法(不会悄悄换成别的数据),需要作者把 API 读取改到页面元素上。没有自动迁移(D2),因为机械删掉 `data` 会让视图静默改读对象。回滚:撤销本 PR 即恢复旧分支,无数据迁移需要回退。objectui 侧的删除(`ApiDataSource` 等)是另一张卡,等 spec 发版后再做,本 PR 不动 objectui。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 本 PR 动了 `skills/**`(受治理,Tier H),需要您的批准才能合入:请审阅上面的中文说明与 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` 的改动(净减 2 行),同意则在 PR 上点 Approve,由席位排队合入。
